results.question: What are the top 10 accounts by pack units this quarter?
results.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name) AS dim0_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s)
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id), COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name)
ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

results.question: Which accounts grew the most versus the prior quarter?
results.sql:
WITH cur AS (
SELECT COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name) AS dim0_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s)
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id), COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name)
), pri AS (
SELECT COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name) AS dim0_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s)
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id), COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name)
)
SELECT COALESCE(c.dim0_id, p.dim0_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(c.dim0_label, p.dim0_label) AS dim0_label, c.value AS current_value, p.value AS prior_value,
       (c.value - p.value) / NULLIF(p.value, 0) AS value
FROM cur c FULL OUTER JOIN pri p ON COALESCE(c.dim0_id::text, %s) = COALESCE(p.dim0_id::text, %s)
ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5001
